items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that passes the context's default LoadTimeWeaver to beans that implement the LoadTimeWeaverAware interface.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 实现，它将上下文的默认 LoadTimeWeaver 传递给实现了 LoadTimeWeaverAware 接口的 Bean。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by @Configuration classes annotated with @EnableLoadTimeWeaving that wish to customize the LoadTimeWeaver instance to be used.

items.source: A Spring-provided extension of the standard Hibernate Configuration class, adding SpringSessionContext as a default and providing convenient ways to specify a JDBC DataSource and an application class loader.
items.translation: Spring 提供的标准 Hibernate Configuration 类的扩展， 默认添加了 SpringSessionContext，并提供便捷的方式来指定 JDBC DataSource 和应用类加载器。

items.source: This is the central class for jakarta.validation (JSR-303) setup in a Spring application context: It bootstraps a jakarta.validation.ValidationFactory and exposes it through the Spring Validator interface as well as through the JSR-303 Validator interface and the ValidatorFactory interface itself.

items.source: A simple log message type for use with Commons Logging, allowing for convenient lazy resolution of a given Supplier instance (typically bound to a lambda expression) or a printf-style format string (String.format(String, Object...)) in its LogMessage.toString().
items.translation: 一种简单的日志消息类型，可与 Commons Logging 配合使用，允许方便地在其 LogMessage.toString() 中延迟解析给定的 Supplier 实例（通常绑定到 lambda 表达式）或 printf 风格的格式字符串 (String.format(String, Object...))。

Return the index of the last byte in this buffer that matches
the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回此缓冲区中匹配给定谓词的最后一个字节的索引。

items.source:
This implementation checks the timestamp of the underlying File,
if available.
items.translation: 此实现会检查底层文件的戳记（如果可用）。

items.source: A common interface defining methods for start/stop lifecycle control.
items.translation: 定义用于启动/停止生命周期控制的常用接口。

items.source: Strategy interface for processing Lifecycle beans within the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于在 ApplicationContext 中处理生命周期 Bean 的策略接口。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when the execution of a listener method failed.
items.translation: 当监听器方法执行失败时抛出的异常。

items.source: Simple factory for shared List instances.
items.translation: 用于共享 List 实例的简单工厂。

items.source: Common superclass for nodes representing literals (boolean, string, number, etc).
items.translation: 表示字面量（布尔值、字符串、数字等）的节点的通用父类。

Load properties from the given InputStream into the given

Load properties from the given Reader into the given
Properties object.

items.translation: 从指定的资源位置加载 Bean 定义。

Load bean definitions into the given bean factory, typically through
delegating to one or more bean definition readers.
items.translation: 将 Bean 定义加载到给定的 BeanFactory 中，通常通过委托给一个或多个 Bean 定义读取器来实现。

Load properties from the given XML InputStream into the
given Properties object.
items.translation: 从给定的 XML InputStream 加载属性到给定的 Properties 对象中。

items.source: Get the local address to which this request is connected, if available.
items.translation: 获取此请求连接的本地地址（如果可用）。

items.source:
Interceptor that allows for changing the current locale on every request,
via a configurable request parameter (default parameter name: "locale").
items.translation: 允许通过可配置的请求参数（默认参数名称为"locale"）在每次请求时更改当前区域的拦截器。

items.source: Strategy interface for determining the current Locale.
items.translation: 用于确定当前区域的策略接口。

items.source:
Simple holder class that associates a LocaleContext instance
with the current thread.
items.translation: 简单的持有类，将 LocaleContext 实例与当前线程关联。

items.source: Add the given locale context resolver to this builder.
items.translation: 将此本地化上下文解析器添加到该构建器中。

items.source:
Interface for web-based locale context resolution strategies that allows
for both locale context resolution via the request and locale context modification
via the HTTP exchange.
items.translation: 用于基于 Web 的区域上下文解析策略的接口，支持通过请求进行区域上下文解析以及通过 HTTP 交换进行修改。

items.source:
Interface for web-based locale resolution strategies that allows for
both locale resolution via the request and locale modification via
request and response.
items.translation: 用于基于 Web 的区域解析策略的接口，支持通过请求进行区域解析，以及通过请求和响应修改区域。

items.source:
Helper class for loading a localized resource,
specified through name, extension and current locale.
items.translation: 用于加载本地化资源的辅助类，该资源通过名称、扩展名和当前区域设置指定。

items.source: Utility methods for formatting and logging messages.
items.translation: 用于格式化日志消息的实用方法。

items.source: Return a log message prefix to use to correlate messages for this exchange.
items.translation: 返回一个日志消息前缀，用于关联此交换的消息。

items.source: Expression language AST node that represents a long integer literal.
items.translation: 表示长整型字面量的表达式语言 AST 节点。

items.source: Perform an actual lookup in the underlying store.
items.translation: 在底层存储中执行实际的查找。

items.source:
Represents an override of a method that looks up an object in the same IoC context,
either by bean name or by bean type (based on the declared method return type).
items.translation: 表示对同一 IoC 上下文中查找对象的方法的重写，该查找可以通过 Bean 名称或 Bean 类型（基于声明的方法返回类型）进行。
